description: Configuration class migrated from AWS S3Client to Azure BlobServiceClient. Replaced static credentials with DefaultAzureCredential and uses endpoint-based initialization.

issues.description: Unused imports: BinaryData, ByteArrayInputStream, and ByteArrayOutputStream are imported but not used in the current implementation. While ByteArrayInputStream and ByteArrayOutputStream are used in the getObject() method, BinaryData is not used in the implementation.
